question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Trust is the most important element of a ______ relationship.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'sound.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 kind
 generous, helpful, and thinking about other people's feelings. (उदार, सहायक और अन्य लोगों की भावनाओं के बारे में सोचने वाला)
 
 

 sound
 in good condition; (of a person) healthy, or (of a thing) not broken or damaged. (अच्छि हालत में; (किसी व्यक्ति का) स्वस्थ, या (किसी चीज़ का) टूटा या क्षतिग्रस्त नहीं)
 
 

 fit
 to be the right size or shape for someone or something. (किसी या किसी चीज़ के लिए सही आकार या आकार होना)
 
 

 humble
 not proud or not believing that you are important. (गर्व नहीं है या विश्वास नहीं है कि आप महत्वपूर्ण हैं)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• The context of the sentence is that the most crucial component of a healthy relationship is trust.
 
• Here "sound" is used as an adjective to modify the noun **'relationship.'**
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill the blank is "sound."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 
• Another example:

 
 
• *Tarun is a person of **sound** mind​.*
 
 

 

Complete Sentence:__ *Trust is the most important element of a __sound__ relationship.*
